    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: >-
                The pet owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName' from the
                stored first and last names.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The pet owner's initials as the upper-cased first letters of the
                first and last names, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The salutation to address the owner by: the title and last name
                separated by a single space (e.g. 'DR Franklin') when a title is
                present, or just the last name when no title is given. Derived on
                read from the stored title and last name.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans: a leading '+'
                and country code, a space, then the national digits grouped in
                threes. Derived on read from the stored 'telephone', which stays
                raw E.164.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The pet owner's customer code formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>', where
                REGION is the region derived from the postcode (falling back to the
                city) and HASH8 is the first 8 upper-case hex characters of the
                SHA-256 digest over the normalized telephone concatenated with the
                last name. Carries no sequence number.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-A1B2C3D4'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                The single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the decimal
                digits contained in the customer code.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 5
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                The deterministic identifier shared by all owners of the same
                household (same last name and postcode), computed as the first
                12 hex characters of the SHA-256 of the normalized last name and
                the postcode joined with '|'. Every owner with the same last name
                and postcode carries the same value automatically; it is always
                assigned.
              type: string
              example: '1A2B3C4D5E6F'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The derived key used for duplicate detection, formed as the
                normalized telephone, the lower-cased email (or empty when
                absent) and the household id (or empty when absent) joined with
                '|'. A new owner is rejected with 409 Conflict only when its
                whole identity key equals an existing owner's.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that shared the same first and
                last name (compared case-insensitively) at the moment this owner
                was created. Assigned once at creation and returned unchanged.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The pet owner's membership number formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>',
                where YY is the last two digits of the fiscal year of the
                (business-day-adjusted) registration date (e.g. 'NSW-A1B2C3D4-M26').
                The fiscal year starts on 1 July, so a registration date on or after
                1 July carries the following calendar year's fiscal year. Assigned
                once at creation and returned unchanged.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-A1B2C3D4-M26'
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The fiscal year of the owner's (business-day-adjusted) registration
                date, formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is the last two digits of the
                fiscal year (e.g. 'FY26'). The fiscal year starts on 1 July, so a
                registration date on or after 1 July belongs to the following
                calendar year's fiscal year. Derived on read from the stored
                registration date.
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The pet owner's membership points, derived from: 0 to start,
                plus 2 when an email address is present, plus 1 when the namesake
                count is 0, plus 2 for a household of 3 or more, and plus 3 for
                tenure of at least one elapsed fiscal year (today's fiscal year is
                later than the registration date's fiscal year).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The pet owner's numeric membership level from 1 to 4, mapped from
                the membership points: level 1 for 0-1 points, level 2 for 2-3,
                level 3 for 4-5, and level 4 for 6 or more.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The canonical region taken from the REGION segment of the owner's
                customer code (the region derived from the postcode, falling back
                to the city), or 'UNKNOWN' when neither resolves to a known region.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The IANA timezone name derived from the owner's locality/region
                via the fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW -> Australia/Sydney,
                VIC -> Australia/Melbourne, QLD -> Australia/Brisbane), or absent
                when the region resolves to no known timezone.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                Whether more than 80 owners had already been created on this
                owner's registration date at the moment this owner was created.
                Assigned once at creation and returned unchanged.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                Whether this owner, though not a hard duplicate, shares an
                existing owner's last name and postcode while carrying a
                different telephone. A declared household member (created with
                'sharesHousehold' true) is never flagged, being a known member
                rather than a suspected duplicate. Assigned once at creation and
                returned unchanged.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this owner is a possible duplicate
                of (shared last name and postcode, different telephone), or
                absent when 'possibleDuplicate' is false. Assigned once at
                creation and returned unchanged.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The pet owner's preferred contact channel, derived from the
                stored contact details: 'EMAIL' when an email address is
                present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The pet owner's age band derived from the birth date, computed
                against the registration date: 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT'
                when 18 to 64, and 'SENIOR' when 65 or older. Absent when no
                birth date is present.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: >-
                Whether this owner has been soft-deleted. A newly created owner
                is false. DELETE /api/owners/{id} marks the owner deleted
                (true) and retains the record; a deleted owner is ignored by the
                create endpoint's duplicate and identity checks.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
    OwnerPage:
      title: Owner page
      description: A page of pet owners.
      type: object
      properties:
        content:
          title: Content
          description: Pet owners in the requested page.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        page:
          title: Page
          description: Zero-based page index.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 0
        size:
          title: Size
          description: Requested page size.
          type: integer

                and postcode carries the same value automatically; it is always
                assigned.
              type: string
              example: '1A2B3C4D5E6F'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The derived key used for duplicate detection, formed as the
                normalized telephone, the lower-cased email (or empty when
                absent) and the household id (or empty when absent) joined with
                '|'. A new owner is rejected with 409 Conflict only when its
                whole identity key equals an existing owner's.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that shared the same first and
                last name (compared case-insensitively) at the moment this owner
                was created. Assigned once at creation and returned unchanged.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The pet owner's membership number formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>',
                where YY is the last two digits of the fiscal year of the
                (business-day-adjusted) registration date (e.g. 'NSW-A1B2C3D4-M26').
                The fiscal year starts on 1 July, so a registration date on or after
                1 July carries the following calendar year's fiscal year. Assigned
                once at creation and returned unchanged.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-A1B2C3D4-M26'
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The fiscal year of the owner's (business-day-adjusted) registration
                date, formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is the last two digits of the
                fiscal year (e.g. 'FY26'). The fiscal year starts on 1 July, so a
                registration date on or after 1 July belongs to the following
                calendar year's fiscal year. Derived on read from the stored
                registration date.
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The pet owner's membership points, derived from: 0 to start,
                plus 2 when an email address is present, plus 1 when the namesake
                count is 0, plus 2 for a household of 3 or more, and plus 3 for
                tenure of at least one elapsed fiscal year (today's fiscal year is
                later than the registration date's fiscal year).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The pet owner's numeric membership level from 1 to 4, mapped from
                the membership points: level 1 for 0-1 points, level 2 for 2-3,
                level 3 for 4-5, and level 4 for 6 or more.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The canonical region taken from the REGION segment of the owner's
                customer code (the region derived from the postcode, falling back
                to the city), or 'UNKNOWN' when neither resolves to a known region.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The IANA timezone name derived from the owner's locality/region
                via the fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW -> Australia/Sydney,
                VIC -> Australia/Melbourne, QLD -> Australia/Brisbane), or absent
                when the region resolves to no known timezone.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                Whether more than 80 owners had already been created on this
                owner's registration date at the moment this owner was created.
                Assigned once at creation and returned unchanged.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                Whether this owner, though not a hard duplicate, shares an
                existing owner's last name and postcode while carrying a
                different telephone. A declared household member (created with
                'sharesHousehold' true) is never flagged, being a known member
                rather than a suspected duplicate. Assigned once at creation and
                returned unchanged.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this owner is a possible duplicate

              type: integer

              example: 1
              readOnly: true

  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The optional honorific title of the pet owner, one of MR, MRS, MS or
            DR. When present it is combined with the last name to form the
            owner's 'salutation'.
          type: string
          enum:
            - MR
            - MRS
            - MS
            - DR
          example: DR
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted for backward
            compatibility; when the structured 'addressLine1' is supplied it is
            preferred and the returned 'address' is composed from the normalized
            structured lines. On read it is the composed, normalized address: the
            normalized 'addressLine1' with a single space and the normalized
            'addressLine2' appended when an 'addressLine2' is present.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '(?s).*\S.*'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address. Optional;
            when a non-blank value is supplied it is preferred over the flat
            'address' input. Stored and returned normalized (trimmed, whitespace
            collapsed, upper-cased and common street-type abbreviations expanded).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '(?s).*\S.*'
          example: '10 King Street'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the pet owner's structured postal address.
            When present it is stored and returned normalized and appended to the
            composed 'address' after a single space.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '(?s).*\S.*'
          example: 'Apartment 4B'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '(?s).*\S.*'
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create the value is
            normalized to E.164 form: a leading '+' and country code are kept
            when present, otherwise country code '+61' is assumed and a single
            leading '0' is dropped from the national digits; spaces, dashes and
            brackets are stripped. The result must carry 8 to 15 digits after
            the '+'. It is then stored and returned in that E.164 form (e.g.
            '0412 345 678' becomes '+61412345678'). A value that cannot form
            valid E.164 is rejected with 400.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: '^\+?[0-9 ()\-]+$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The optional email address of the pet owner. When present it must be
            a syntactically valid address; it is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$'
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The optional 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. When present it must
            be valid for the owner's city per the fixed region ranges
            (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099 for cities in the
            Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD table); a city with no
            known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. A malformed or
            out-of-range postcode is rejected with 400. It is stored and
            returned unchanged.
          type: string
          minLength: 4
          maxLength: 4
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            When omitted on create the server sets it to its current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The optional date of birth of the pet owner, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD'
            format. When present it is used to derive the owner's 'ageBand'
            (computed against the registration date).
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true, allows creating this owner even if another owner already
            belongs to the same household (same last name and postcode, and
            therefore the same household id); it only bypasses the household
            duplicate block and the owner is created as a declared household
            member (never flagged as a possible duplicate). Write-only; it is
            not persisted or returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: >-
                The pet owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName' from the
                stored first and last names.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The pet owner's initials as the upper-cased first letters of the
                first and last names, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The salutation to address the owner by: the title and last name
                separated by a single space (e.g. 'DR Franklin') when a title is
                present, or just the last name when no title is given. Derived on
                read from the stored title and last name.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans: a leading '+'
                and country code, a space, then the national digits grouped in
                threes. Derived on read from the stored 'telephone', which stays
                raw E.164.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The pet owner's customer code formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>', where
                REGION is the region derived from the postcode (falling back to the
                city) and HASH8 is the first 8 upper-case hex characters of the
                SHA-256 digest over the normalized telephone concatenated with the
                last name. Carries no sequence number.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-A1B2C3D4'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                The single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the decimal
                digits contained in the customer code.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 5
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                The deterministic identifier shared by all owners of the same
                household (same last name and postcode), computed as the first
                12 hex characters of the SHA-256 of the normalized last name and
                the postcode joined with '|'. Every owner with the same last name
                and postcode carries the same value automatically; it is always
                assigned.
              type: string
              example: '1A2B3C4D5E6F'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The derived key used for duplicate detection, formed as the
                normalized telephone, the lower-cased email (or empty when
                absent) and the household id (or empty when absent) joined with
                '|'. A new owner is rejected with 409 Conflict only when its
                whole identity key equals an existing owner's.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that shared the same first and
                last name (compared case-insensitively) at the moment this owner
                was created. Assigned once at creation and returned unchanged.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The pet owner's membership number formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>',
                where YY is the last two digits of the fiscal year of the
                (business-day-adjusted) registration date (e.g. 'NSW-A1B2C3D4-M26').
                The fiscal year starts on 1 July, so a registration date on or after
                1 July carries the following calendar year's fiscal year. Assigned
                once at creation and returned unchanged.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-A1B2C3D4-M26'
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The fiscal year of the owner's (business-day-adjusted) registration
                date, formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is the last two digits of the
                fiscal year (e.g. 'FY26'). The fiscal year starts on 1 July, so a
                registration date on or after 1 July belongs to the following
                calendar year's fiscal year. Derived on read from the stored
                registration date.
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The pet owner's membership points, derived from: 0 to start,
                plus 2 when an email address is present, plus 1 when the namesake
                count is 0, plus 2 for a household of 3 or more, and plus 3 for
                tenure of at least one elapsed fiscal year (today's fiscal year is
                later than the registration date's fiscal year).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The pet owner's numeric membership level from 1 to 4, mapped from
                the membership points: level 1 for 0-1 points, level 2 for 2-3,
                level 3 for 4-5, and level 4 for 6 or more.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The canonical region taken from the REGION segment of the owner's
                customer code (the region derived from the postcode, falling back
                to the city), or 'UNKNOWN' when neither resolves to a known region.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The IANA timezone name derived from the owner's locality/region
                via the fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW -> Australia/Sydney,
                VIC -> Australia/Melbourne, QLD -> Australia/Brisbane), or absent
                when the region resolves to no known timezone.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                Whether more than 80 owners had already been created on this
                owner's registration date at the moment this owner was created.
                Assigned once at creation and returned unchanged.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                Whether this owner, though not a hard duplicate, shares an
                existing owner's last name and postcode while carrying a
                different telephone. A declared household member (created with
                'sharesHousehold' true) is never flagged, being a known member
                rather than a suspected duplicate. Assigned once at creation and
                returned unchanged.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this owner is a possible duplicate
                of (shared last name and postcode, different telephone), or
                absent when 'possibleDuplicate' is false. Assigned once at
                creation and returned unchanged.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The pet owner's preferred contact channel, derived from the
                stored contact details: 'EMAIL' when an email address is
                present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The pet owner's age band derived from the birth date, computed
                against the registration date: 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT'
                when 18 to 64, and 'SENIOR' when 65 or older. Absent when no
                birth date is present.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true

              title: Deleted
              description: >-
                Whether this owner has been soft-deleted. A newly created owner
                is false. DELETE /api/owners/{id} marks the owner deleted
                (true) and retains the record; a deleted owner is ignored by the
                create endpoint's duplicate and identity checks.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:

This follows the codebase's existing idiom for derived read-only fields. `Tests run: 1, Failures: 0, Errors: 0` — **BUILD SUCCESS**.
